scope.production_change: Before allocating, writing, fsyncing, quarantining, and publishing a temporary download, probe the candidate through the already pinned Downloads directory descriptor with fstatat(AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW). Existing regular files and leaf symlinks are treated as occupied. Only ENOENT proceeds. Other probe errors fail closed.
scope.race_safety: The preprobe is advisory. The existing descriptor-relative exclusive publish remains the authority when another process creates the target after the probe. Directory identity verification and temporary-file cleanup remain unchanged.

prior_native_evidence.observed: The safe 32-byte attachment was published without a partial snapshot during the Save All collision exercise.
prior_native_evidence.limitation: The 10,000 unsafe-name collision sequence remained in progress after more than three minutes because the prior implementation performed durable temporary work for each occupied candidate. It is correctness evidence only, not a completed optimized timing result.

regression_tests.name: native_attachment_save_skips_existing_collision_names_before_durable_temporary_work
regression_tests.coverage: 9,999 occupied names, including a leaf symlink; asserts one write, one quarantine operation, one temporary allocation, final name report (9999).pdf, and an unchanged symlink target.

regression_tests.name: native_attachment_save_rechecks_exclusivity_when_a_leaf_appears_after_the_probe
regression_tests.coverage: A leaf symlink appears after the absence probe; exclusive publish skips it and preserves its target.

regression_tests.name: native_attachment_save_exhausts_existing_names_without_temporary_work
regression_tests.coverage: All 10,000 candidate names exist; the operation fails without writing, quarantining, or allocating a temporary file.

regression_tests.name: native_attachment_save_fails_closed_when_the_descriptor_probe_errors
regression_tests.coverage: A descriptor probe error stops the operation before writing, quarantining, or allocating a temporary file.

sensitivity.method: Temporarily replaced only private_download_candidate_exists_at with Ok(false), reproducing the former publish-only collision discovery, then restored the fstatat implementation.
sensitivity.outcome: failed as expected in 3.33 seconds before restoration
sensitivity.assertion: occupied names must not be written and fsynced: writes was 10000, expected 1
sensitivity.restoration: The helper was restored before the positive runs.
